IN CIVIL MISC. NO.5 OF 2015  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:8018  WP No. 201911 of 2024 PASSED BY LEARNED SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC,
CHINCHOLI DATED 10.12.2021 VIDE ANNEUXRE-C, WITHIN A STIPULATED TIME; ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS DIRECTING THE RESPONDENT NO.1 TO CONSIDER THE REPRESENTATION OF THE PETITIONER VIDE ANNEXURE-D DATED 10.01.2022 AND CONSEQUENTLY SEND THE REFERENCE PAPERS TO REFERENCE COURT AND ETC.
 THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) In this petition, the petitioner has sought for the following reliefs:
"i) Issue a writ of mandamus directing the Respondent No.1 to comply the order in Civil Misc. No.5 of 2015 passed by learned Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Chincholi dated 10.12.2021 vide Annexure-C, within a stipulated time;
 ii) Issue a writ of mandamus directing the  Respondent No.1 to consider the  representation of the petitioner vide  Annexure-D dated 10.01.2022 and consequently send the reference papers to reference court.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:8018 iii) Issue any other order, direction or writ as this Hon'ble Court deemed fit in the facts and circumstances of the case as stated above with costs."
2.

A perusal of the material on record will indicate that, in proceedings under Section 28 (A) (3) of the Land Acquisition Act, the Special Land Acquisition Officer has determined the compensation and passed the award directing the compensation to be paid in favour of the petitioner.

Being aggrieved/dissatisfied by the quantum of compensation, the petitioner filed a petition in Civil Misc.
Neelamma vs Special Land Acquisiton Officer And Anr on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171172985/
2 No.5/2015, seeking for reference under Section 28 (A) (3) of the Land Acquisition Act and since respondents did not take any steps in this regard even till today, the petitioner is before this Court by way of the present petition.
3. The aforesaid facts and circumstances clearly indicate that the petitioner had invoked his right to seek reference for enhancement of compensation by filing Civil Misc. No.05/2015, which was allowed on 10.12.2021 and the representation submitted by the petitioner seeking NC:
2024:KHC-K:8018 compliance of the same having not been done by the respondents, it would be just and appropriate to dispose of this petition directing respondent No.1 to take necessary steps to comply with the order dated 10.12.2021 passed in Civil Misc. No.05/2015 and refer the matter to the Reference Court to proceed further in accordance with law within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4. With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed of.
Sd/-
(S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) JUDGE LG Neelamma vs Special Land Acquisiton Officer And Anr on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171172985/
